summary: App with admin panel (Internet Identity auth, principal-based access control), admin music upload (all users can toggle playback via top-right button), countdown timer with reset, and day/night light/dark mode toggle in the top navigation bar.
architectural_notes: Uses Internet Identity (ICP) for admin authentication with principal-based access control

new_feature_requests.summary: Admin panel with Internet Identity authentication and principal-based access control
Admin can upload background music; all users hear it and can toggle play/pause via top-right button
Countdown timer with set duration and reset/set-back functionality
Day/night light/dark mode toggle in the top navigation bar

Replace the existing password-based AdminUnlock screen with Internet Identity authentication. Only users whose principal is in a hardcoded or backend-stored admin principal allowlist can access the admin panel. Non-admin principals are shown an 'Access Denied' message after login. The AdminView must gate all admin sub-views behind this II-based check.

Add a music upload feature to the AdminSettings panel. The admin can upload an audio file (e.g. MP3) which is stored in the backend as a blob. All users' clients fetch and play this track as background music. A play/pause toggle button is placed in the top-right corner of the top navigation bar and is visible to all users regardless of login state.

Implement a configurable countdown timer visible to all users. The admin can set a target duration or target datetime from the admin panel. The timer displays hours, minutes, and seconds counting down. The admin can also reset/set-back the timer to a new value at any time. The timer state (target time) is persisted in the backend so all users see the same countdown.

Add a day/night (light/dark mode) toggle button to the top navigation bar. Clicking it switches the entire app between light and dark themes. The user's preference is persisted in localStorage. The toggle should use a sun/moon icon and be placed alongside other top-bar controls.
